name: @distrb-pglite/node
description: Node.js adapters for distrb-pglite: DistributedPGlite facade, PGlite partition store, WebSocket transport, CAS snapshot, and storage orchestration.

scripts.test: vitest run --testTimeout=30000 --fileParallelism=false --exclude test/cas.test.ts --exclude test/inventory.test.ts --exclude test/partition-snapshot.test.ts --exclude test/pglite-cas-filesystem-integration.test.ts --exclude test/pglite-store.test.ts --exclude test/storage-binding.test.ts --exclude test/storage-orchestration.test.ts --exclude test/transaction-boundary-pbt.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --fileParallelism=false --testTimeout=120000 --hookTimeout=30000 test/cas.test.ts test/inventory.test.ts test/partition-snapshot.test.ts test/pglite-cas-filesystem-integration.test.ts test/pglite-store.test.ts test/storage-binding.test.ts test/storage-orchestration.test.ts test/transaction-boundary-pbt.test.ts
